rules.entry: close > SMA(close,200) AND Wilder RSI(close,14) <40. Daily condition, not crossing event. Strict inequalities.
rules.exit: Wilder RSI14 >60 OR close > SMA(close,5). Strict inequalities.
rules.SMA: arithmetic means including current completed candle; 200 bars required for entry, first valid at index199
rules.RSI: delta=close-close[1]; gain=max(delta,0),loss=max(-delta,0); initial avgGain/avgLoss at index14 = SMA of first14 price changes; later RMA=(13*previous+current)/14; RSI=100-100/(1+avgGain/avgLoss); loss==0 gives100, gain==0 with loss>0 gives0
rules.execution: at each completed close, if flat and entry true schedule next available symbol session open entry; if long and exit true schedule next available open exit. One long per symbol. ATR irrelevant.
rules.overlap: when flat, entry is allowed even if exit also true; cannot schedule an exit before position exists. At entry-day close exit may trigger earliest next-open exit. After open exit, that close may schedule reentry for following open. Never simultaneous entry+exit on same open.
rules.terminal: no forced closing; open positions separately marked; final entry/exit signals unfilled and reported pending
rules.costs: gross returns; zero brokerage, taxes, spread and slippage
rules.portfolio_DD: unavailable, no sizing/capital constraints/mark-to-market portfolio equity model
rules.coverage: same 692 current exact-universe stocks as prior strategies; 52 missing and seven stale excluded; no remapping or repeat Fyers attempts
limitations: present-day fixed mirrored universe gives survivorship bias
mixed Turso corporate-action adjustment consistency not independently verified
missing sessions/short history may distort rolling indicators; full200bar warmup enforced
zero costs and unlimited concurrent positions overstate implementability

caveats: Historical closed-trade arithmetic statistics, not portfolio returns. Open trades excluded. No equal-capital sizing, compounding, equity curve, CAGR, or portfolio drawdown.
Gross zero costs; present-day universe survivorship bias; mixed-source corporate-action adjustments and missing sessions remain unverified. Extreme returns are data-sensitive, not recommendations.
